items.title: Scientists Used AI to Create 16 New Viruses
items.summary: The use of AI systems to create viruses opens up new possibilities for combating bacterial resistance. It also raises concerns about the pace at which technology is outstripping regulation.
items.author: Fernanda González

items.title: The Hottest New AI Chatbot Is Just a Guy Answering Your Questions
items.summary: WIRED spoke with Tucker Bryant, an artist and former Google employee who created ChatTJB to get people to reflect on the “strange moment” we’re in.
items.author: Caroline Haskins
